Introductions

Introductions #

I am an enthusiast photographer who mostly enjoys landscape and travel photography on both analog and digital systems! You can see a more detailed collection of my works in my art blog. Additionally, I post some of the pieces on my instagram (@jwu_arts) account, so feel free to give it a follow if you are interested in seeing more of my works.

Besides photography, I also enjoy making digital pieces in my free time. Pixel art, with its nostalgic charm, challenges me to express detailed ideas within the constraints of limited resolution and color-palletes, while vector art allows me to fuse my appreciation for technology into artistic expressions.
